title: Restore the studio router
goal: Restore the internet connection without guessing or skipping safety checks.

steps.title: Inspect the setup
steps.instruction: Photograph the router, power adapter, and visible cables before touching anything.
steps.expectedEvidence: The router and cable ends are visible, the area is dry, and no cable or connector appears damaged.
steps.safety: Stop if you see water, heat damage, exposed conductors, smoke, or swelling.

attempts.observed: Router, adapter, and connectors are visible on a dry surface with no visible damage.
attempts.reason: The safety preconditions and required objects are all visible.

steps.title: Connect power
steps.instruction: Insert the matching power adapter into the router's DC-IN socket, then photograph the connection.
steps.expectedEvidence: The barrel connector is fully seated in DC-IN and the cable is not under tension.
steps.safety: Use only the adapter specified for the router.

attempts.observed: The matching barrel connector is fully seated in the socket labelled DC-IN.
attempts.reason: Connector geometry, label, and cable position match the expected proof.

steps.title: Connect the internet cable
steps.instruction: Insert the incoming internet cable into the WAN/Internet port and photograph the port labels.
steps.expectedEvidence: The cable is latched into the port labelled WAN or Internet, not a numbered LAN port.
steps.safety: Do not force the connector. Its latch should face the port notch.

attempts.observed: The yellow internet cable is inserted into LAN 1 while the blue WAN port is empty.
attempts.reason: The physical state contradicts the current instruction. The next step remains locked.

attempts.observed: The internet cable is now latched into the port labelled WAN.
attempts.reason: The corrected photo clearly shows the WAN label and empty numbered LAN port.

steps.title: Verify the result
steps.instruction: Wait up to two minutes, then photograph the full router status panel.
steps.expectedEvidence: Power is stable and the Internet/WAN indicator shows the router's normal connected state.
steps.safety: If the router becomes unusually hot or smells burnt, disconnect power.

attempts.observed: Power, Internet, and Wi-Fi indicators are stable in their connected state.
attempts.reason: The final status panel provides visible completion evidence.
